crossRefs.note: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon…
My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for…
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
“My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not…
Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there…
He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

translations.web: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
translations.bsb: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
translations.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
translations.asv: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
